basic_info.description: The history of 852 Treat began about 1864 when an Irish Immigrant bought the parcel at a land auction, during the civil war years.  The rear house (854) was built first, then 852 was added in about 1886.  The 1906 earthquake wasn't for another 20 years. The current owners condo converted in 2006.    A lot has happened to the neighborhood and the city in the last 160 years.  Looking at the property though the lens of our time, the property is sought after; a terrific location at the heart of Mission life, a little off the beaten path; a respite from its vibrance.  Go in any direction from the home and get to restaurants, coffee shops, local businesses, transit and access to freeways.    852 Treat has been lovingly upgraded and maintained over the owners 40 year ownership, while maintaining the period detail and architectural integrity of the two bedroom home.  Upgrades include a remodeled kitchen and bathroom, hardwood floors, central heat, and a private garage.
